A '''Gas Feed Regulator''' was a weapon component. The [[E-Web heavy repeating blaster/Legends|E-Web heavy repeating blaster]] had a Gas Feed Regulator at the rear of the weapon, near to the [[gas refill valve]].<ref name="EGWT" />
